founders_plan_delaware_llc_s_election_in.assumptions: COUNTERFACTUAL: Tomas was ineligible as a shareholder on supplied 2026 facts; 2027 eligibility is unknown, so this is not an established available plan for the hypothetical 2027 calendar year. Assumes the projected $260,000 before owner pay excludes the modeled California charge. $610,000 receipts; $260,000 before owner pay; $40,000 wage each. Assumed 15.3% combined employee/employer payroll on $80,000 wages = $12,240; half, $6,120, is employer expense. Assumes all $610,000 receipts fall in the California LLC fee base (geographic base unverified) and the $800+$2,500=$3,300 state charge reduces pass-through income (deductibility unverified). Pass-through after wages, employer payroll and CA charge = $260,000-$80,000-$6,120-$3,300=$170,580, or $85,290 each; illustrative 25% founder income tax on $40,000+$85,290=$125,290 is $31,322.50 each. $3,300+$31,322.50+$31,322.50+$12,240=$78,185. Excludes Delaware cost, potentially taxable service stock, California/Mexico income taxes and cross-border items. The $40,000 wage may be unreasonable.

recommended_california_llc_partnership_5.assumptions: Illustrative 2027 calendar year. Assumes the projected $260,000 before owner pay excludes the modeled California charge. $610,000 receipts; $260,000 before owner compensation; no guaranteed payments or wages. Assumes all $610,000 receipts fall in the California LLC fee base (geographic base unverified) and the $800 annual tax + $2,500 receipts fee = $3,300 state charge reduces allocable income (deductibility unverified). $260,000-$3,300=$256,700 available for 50/50 profit allocation from grant, including the unvested period, $128,350 each. Assumed flat 25% founder income tax = $32,087.50 each. Assumed 15.3% self-employment tax proxy on entire $256,700 = $39,275.10, placed in payroll_taxes to keep the requested schema. $3,300+$32,087.50+$32,087.50+$39,275.10=$106,750.10. No deduction for self-employment tax or §199A. Cross-border tax, withholding, state personal income tax, sourcing, Mexico tax and actual rates are unknown; employment tax treatment is unverified by the library.
